notes: Form 425 filing of SLR Investment Corp.'s 8-K (Item 1.01) announcing the Agreement and Plan of Merger dated December 1, 2021 with SLR Senior Investment Corp. (BDC-into-BDC). Two-step structure: Merger Sub merges into SUNS, then SUNS merges into SLRC, SLRC surviving; recorded as one merger event with one target. The filing uses 'SLRC' and 'SUNS' as defined short names for SLR Investment Corp. and SLR Senior Investment Corp.; only SLRC is printed as an exchange trading symbol (cover table, Nasdaq Global Select Market), so subject_tickers is SLRC alone; SUNS is not printed as a ticker in the excerpt. Exchange basis: each SUNS share converts into SLRC shares equal to an Exchange Ratio computed as SUNS per-share NAV divided by SLRC per-share NAV at a Determination Date no earlier than 48 hours before the Effective Time; no fixed ratio is stated, so exchange_ratio is null; cash only in lieu of fractional shares, so cash_per_share is null. Collar not stated. Conditions come from the 8-K's 'Conditions to the Mergers' summary; condition (6) 'absence of certain governmental impediments' is covered by legal_injunction/regulatory_approval; (7) NAV determinations, (8) SLRC base management fee reduction (1.75% to 1.50%) and (9) accuracy of representations/compliance with covenants are mapped to other. The agreement's own Article VIII conditions and Article IX termination sections fall after the excerpt cut; no tax-opinion condition is stated in the excerpt (the parties only 'intend' Section 368(a) treatment). Termination fees stated (not schema fields): approximately $25,604,700 (third party acquiring SLRC pays SUNS) and approximately $7,572,270 (third party acquiring SUNS pays SLRC). No meeting or record date stated. Text quirk: quotation marks and apostrophes appear to be missing from this excerpt as displayed (e.g. 'SLRCs', '(SLRC)'); spans are copied exactly as displayed and mostly avoid those spots, but the shareholder_approval span contains 'SLRCs and SUNSs'.
